features.description: Core: assignments, locals/storage aliases, push/pop/delete, conditionals/block, require/assert/revert, bounded-normal loop and scalar internal call subject to guards. Not a Solidity-source acceptance theorem.
features.predicate:
def inFrag {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) : Solidity.Stmt C Γ Γ' → Option (Frag Γ')
  | .assign l r => F.guard (assignIn F r l)
  | .rebind i r => match r with
    | .path q => (bindFl F q).map (F.set i)
    | .push .. => none
  | .assignLocal _ r => F.guard (valIn F r)
  | .declLocal p _ init => (F.push (.val p) .ok).guard (init.all (valIn F))
  | .declStorage R _ init => declStorageIn F R init
  | .opAssign _ _ _ l r => F.guard (opLocIn F l && valIn F r)
  | .incDec _ _ l => F.guard (opLocIn F l)
  | .assignIncDec _ _ _ l _ => F.guard (opLocIn F l)
  | .push b v _ => F.guard (pushIn F v b)
  | .pop b => F.dropFragile.guard (spathIn F false b)
  | .transfer r a => F.guard (valIn F r && valIn F a)
  | @Solidity.Stmt.delete _ _ T l => F.dropFragile.guard (leavesFit T && locIn F false l)
  | .ite c t e =>
    if valIn F c then
      match inFragP F t, inFragP F e with
      | some F₁, some F₂ => some ((F₁.restrict Γ).meet (F₂.restrict Γ))
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  | .block body => (inFragP F body).map (Frag.restrict Γ)
  | .require c | .assert c => F.guard (valIn F c)
  | .revert => some F
  | .assumeFalse => none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.call _ _ _ ps rs _ _ args ret body =>
    if argsIn F args then
      match inFragP (Frag.init (rs ++ ps)) body with
      | some _ => CallRetIn (F.after (Prog.shrinks body)) ret
      | none => none
    else none
  -- a loop whose body pushes, pays, shrinks nothing and leaves what is known
  -- of the locals as it found it: every turn starts from the same fragment
  | .loop _ c body =>
    if valIn F c && Prog.pushes body == 0 && !Prog.pays body && !Prog.shrinks body then
      match inFragP F body with
      | some G => if (G.restrict Γ).fl = F.fl then some F else none
      | none => none
    else none
  | .assignLocalPush .. | .send .. | .declMem .. | .rebindMem .. | .assignFromMem ..
  | .assignMem .. | .deleteMem ..
  | .assignNew .. | .tryCall .. | .revertData _ | .catchData .. | .pushOpAssign .. | .pushIncDec ..
  | .callReceiver .. => none
  | .callReceiverPush .. => none
  -- recursion is outside the compiled fragment
  | .callRec .. => none

features.description: Primitive expressions with recursive guards; map keys uint; offsets/fixed array sizes fit W; fragile aliases tracked. Core excludes memory reads/length, modular/hash expressions.
features.predicate:
def spathIn {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) (free : Bool) : {T : Ty} → Solidity.SPath C Γ T → Bool
  | _, .alias i => F.get i == .ok || (!free && F.get i == .fragile)
  | _, .loc l => locIn F free l
def locIn {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) (free : Bool) : {T : Ty} → Solidity.Loc C Γ T → Bool
  | _, .root .. => true
  | _, @Solidity.Loc.field _ _ s _ b f _ => decide (offset s f < W) && spathIn F free b
  | _, @Solidity.Loc.index _ _ _ k _ .map b i => k == .uint && spathIn F free b && valIn F i
  | _, .index (.arr .dyn) b i => !free && spathIn F free b && valIn F i
  | _, .index (.arr (.fixed (n := n))) b i =>
    !free && decide (n < W) && spathIn F free b && valIn F i
def valIn {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) : {p : PrimTy} → Solidity.Val C Γ p → Bool
  | _, .simple s => simpleIn s
  | _, .read l => locIn F false l
  | _, @Solidity.Val.binop _ _ p _ op _ _ a b => binInFrag op p && valIn F a && valIn F b
  | _, @Solidity.Val.unop _ _ p _ op _ _ a => unInFrag op p && valIn F a
  | _, .ternary c a b => valIn F c && valIn F a && valIn F b
  | _, .len b _ => spathIn F false b
  | _, .readMem _ | _, .mlen .. | _, .modular .. | _, .hash .. => false
end

features.description: Core: scalar args and zero/single scalar return. Reject reference args and multi/reference returns. Payment refusal remains observable in the legacy compiler theorem.
features.predicate:
def argsIn {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) : {ps : Ctx} → Solidity.Args C Γ ps → Bool
  | _, .nil => true
  | _, .snoc as _ _ e => argsIn F as && valIn F e
  | _, .snocStorage .. | _, .snocMemory .. => false

/-- What a call leaves the caller knowing: nothing new for no return or one
return value; calls exporting several returns, memory or storage aliases are out. -/
def CallRetIn {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) : {rs Γ' : Ctx} → Solidity.CallRet Γ rs Γ' →
    Option (Frag Γ')
  | _, _, .none => some F
  | _, _, .val .. => some F
  | _, _, .rets _ => none
  | _, _, .mem .. => none
  | _, _, .storage .. => none

  | _, _ => true

def compileVal (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    {p : PrimTy} → (e : Val C Γ p) → Option (CompiledVal b F e)
  | _, .readMem (.index .dyn (.var src hm) i) =>
    do
      let index ← compileVal b F i
      pure ⟨_, .read src hm i index.code index.cert⟩
  | _, @Solidity.Val.mlen _ _ _ (.prim _) (.var src hm) rfl => some ⟨_, .length src hm⟩
  | _, .readMem (.field (.var src hm) _ hf) => some ⟨_, .field src hm hf⟩
  | _, .readMem (.index .dyn src i) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    pure ⟨_, .pathRead src pointer.code pointer.cert i index.code index.cert⟩
  | _, @Solidity.Val.mlen _ _ _ (.prim _) src rfl => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨_, .pathLength src pointer.code pointer.cert⟩
  | _, .readMem (.field src _ hf) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨_, .pathField src hf pointer.code pointer.cert⟩
  | _, @Solidity.Val.binop _ _ p _ op hacc rfl x y =>
    if hop : binInFrag op p = true then do
      let left ← compileVal b F x
      let right ← compileVal b F y
      pure ⟨_, .binary op hop hacc x y left.code right.code left.cert right.cert⟩
    else none
  | _, @Solidity.Val.unop _ _ p _ op hacc rfl x =>
    if hop : unInFrag op p = true then do
      let operand ← compileVal b F x
      pure ⟨_, .unary op hop hacc x operand.code operand.cert⟩
    else none
  | _, .ternary c x y => do
    let cond ← compileVal b F c
    let left ← compileVal b F x
    let right ← compileVal b F y
    pure ⟨_, .conditional c x y cond.code left.code right.code cond.cert left.cert right.cert⟩
  | _, e => if he : valIn F e = true then some ⟨_, .core e he⟩ else none

/-- No value compiler result is trusted: its clause proves the typed result. -/
acceptors.name: compileVal

def compileBump (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) {p : PrimTy}
    (op : IncDec) (hp : p.isNumeric = true) (l : OpLoc C Γ p) :
    Option {code : List Instr // StmtFrag b F F (.incDec op hp l) code} :=
  match l with
  | .mindex .dyn (.var dst hm) i => do
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp
      (.readMem (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) (.simple i))) one
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementMemory F op hp .dyn (.var dst hm) i _
      (.compoundMemory F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp .dyn (.var dst hm) i one _
        (.write F dst hm (.simple i) valueExpr index.code value.code index.cert value.cert))⟩
  | .mfield (.var dst hm) f hf => do
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp
      (.readMem (.field (.var dst hm) f hf)) one
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementField F op hp (.var dst hm) f hf _
      (.compoundField F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp (.var dst hm) f hf one _
        (.writeField F dst hm hf valueExpr value.code value.cert))⟩
  | .mindex .dyn src i => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp
      (.readMem (.index .dyn src (.simple i))) one
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementMemory F op hp .dyn src i _
      (.compoundMemory F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp .dyn src i one _
        (.writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert (.simple i) valueExpr
          index.code value.code index.cert value.cert))⟩
  | .mfield src f hf => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp (.readMem (.field src f hf)) one
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementField F op hp src f hf _
      (.compoundField F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp src f hf one _
        (.writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf valueExpr value.code value.cert))⟩
  | .local dst => do
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp (.simple (.local dst)) one
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementLocal F op hp dst _
      (.compoundLocal F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp dst one _
        (.assign F dst valueExpr value.code value.cert))⟩
  | _ => none

def compileStmt (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F s)
  | .assignLocal dst e => do
    let value ← compileVal b F e
    pure ⟨F, _, .assign F dst e value.code value.cert⟩
  | .declLocal p x (some e) => do
    let value ← compileVal b F e
    pure ⟨F.push (.val p) .ok, _, .declare F x e value.code value.cert⟩
  | .declLocal p x none => some ⟨F.push (.val p) .ok, _, .declareDefault F p x⟩
  | .rebindMem dst (.alias (.var src hm)) =>
    some ⟨F, _, .rebind F dst src hm⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.rebindMem _ _ (.array (.prim p)) dst (.newArr n _) =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then some ⟨F, _, .reallocate F p dst n hb hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem R x (some (.alias (.var src hm))) _ _ =>
    some ⟨F.push (.mem R) .ok, _, .declareAlias F x src hm⟩
  | .rebindMem dst (.alias src) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨F, _, .rebindPath F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert⟩
  | .declMem R x (some (.alias src)) _ hm => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨F.push (.mem R) .ok, _, .declarePathAlias F x src hm pointer.code pointer.cert⟩
  | .declMem (.struct s) x none hd hm =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      match hc : defaultCode? (.struct s) with
      | none => none
      | some data => some ⟨F.push (.mem (.struct s)) .ok, _,
          .allocateStruct F s x hd hm hb data (defaultCode_sound hc)⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.assignNew _ _ (.array (.prim _)) (.mem (.field src _ hf)) n _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then do
        let pointer ← compilePtr b src
        pure ⟨F, _, .allocateArrayField F src hf n pointer.code pointer.cert hb hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem (.struct s) x (some (.copy (.loc (.root root hr)) _)) _ hm =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then do
        let loads ← compileCopyLoads b F root hr (Semantics.structDef s)
        pure ⟨F.push (.mem (.struct s)) .ok, _, .copyStruct F s x root hr hm hb hp loads.code loads.cert⟩
      else none
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.rebindMem _ _ (.struct s) dst (.copy (.loc (.root root hr)) hm) =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then do
        let loads ← compileCopyLoads b F root hr (Semantics.structDef s)
        pure ⟨F, _, .rebindCopyStruct F s dst root hr hm hb hp loads.code loads.cert⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem (.array (.prim p)) x (some (.newArr n _)) _ _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then
        some ⟨F.push (.mem (.array (.prim p))) .ok, _, .allocate F p x n hb hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem (.array (.prim p)) x none _ _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      some ⟨F.push (.mem (.array (.prim p))) .ok, _,
        .defaultArray F p x _ (.allocate F p x (.lit 0 rfl) hb rfl)⟩
    else none
  | .assignMem (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) i) (.val v) => do
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .write F dst hm i v index.code value.code index.cert value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.field (.var dst hm) _ hf) (.val v) => do
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .writeField F dst hm hf v value.code value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.index .dyn src i) (.val v) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert i v index.code value.code index.cert value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.field src _ hf) (.val v) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf v value.code value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.field dst _ hf) (.ref src) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b dst
    let value ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨F, _, .writeReference F dst src hf pointer.code value.code pointer.cert value.cert⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim _) (.loc (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) i)) _ => do
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    pure ⟨F, _, .deleteElement F dst hm i index.code index.cert⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.array (.prim p))) (.var dst _) _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      some ⟨F, _, .deleteArray F dst _ (.reallocate F p dst (.lit 0 rfl) hb rfl)⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.struct s)) (.var dst hm) hd =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      match hc : defaultCode? (.struct s) with
      | none => none
      | some data => some ⟨F, _, .deleteStruct F dst hd hm hb data (defaultCode_sound hc)⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.array (.prim _))) (.loc (.field src _ hf)) _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then do
      let pointer ← compilePtr b src
      pure ⟨F, _, .deleteArrayField F src hf pointer.code pointer.cert hb⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.struct t)) (.loc (.field src f hf)) hd =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      match hc : defaultCode? (.struct t) with
      | none => none
      | some data => do
        let pointer ← compilePtr b src
        pure ⟨F, _, .deleteStructField F src hf hd (MLoc.field src f hf).mapFree
          pointer.code pointer.cert hb data (defaultCode_sound hc)⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim p) (.loc (.field (.var dst hm) _ hf)) _ => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (deleteDefaultValue p)
    pure ⟨F, _, .deleteField F (.var dst hm) hf _
      (.writeField F dst hm hf (deleteDefaultValue p) value.code value.cert)⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim p) (.loc (.index .dyn src i)) _ => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    let value ← compileVal b F (deleteDefaultValue p)
    pure ⟨F, _, .deletePathElement F src i _
      (.writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert i (deleteDefaultValue p)
        index.code value.code index.cert value.cert)⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim p) (.loc (.field src _ hf)) _ => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let value ← compileVal b F (deleteDefaultValue p)
    pure ⟨F, _, .deleteField F src hf _
      (.writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf (deleteDefaultValue p) value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mindex .dyn (.var dst hm) i) r => do
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) (.simple i))) r
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundMemory F op hop hp .dyn (.var dst hm) i r _
      (.write F dst hm (.simple i) valueExpr index.code value.code index.cert value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.local dst) r => do
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.simple (.local dst)) r
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundLocal F op hop hp dst r _ (.assign F dst valueExpr value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mfield (.var dst hm) f hf) r => do
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.field (.var dst hm) f hf)) r
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundField F op hop hp (.var dst hm) f hf r _
      (.writeField F dst hm hf valueExpr value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mindex .dyn src i) r => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.index .dyn src (.simple i))) r
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundMemory F op hop hp .dyn src i r _
      (.writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert (.simple i) valueExpr
        index.code value.code index.cert value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mfield src f hf) r => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.field src f hf)) r
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundField F op hop hp src f hf r _
      (.writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf valueExpr value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .incDec op hp l => do
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp l
    pure ⟨F, bump.val, bump.property⟩
  | .assignIncDec dst op hp (.mindex .dyn (.var src hm) i) hrecv => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (bumpResultValue op hp
      (.readMem (.index .dyn (.var src hm) (.simple i))))
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp (.mindex .dyn (.var src hm) i)
    pure ⟨F, _, .captureMemory F dst op hp .dyn (.var src hm) i hrecv
      value.code bump.val value.cert bump.property⟩
  | .assignIncDec dst op hp (.local src) hrecv => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (bumpResultValue op hp (.simple (.local src)))
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp (.local src)
    pure ⟨F, _, .captureLocal F dst op hp src hrecv value.code bump.val value.cert bump.property⟩
  | .assignIncDec dst op hp (.mfield (.var src hm) f hf) hrecv => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (bumpResultValue op hp (.readMem (.field (.var src hm) f hf)))
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp (.mfield (.var src hm) f hf)
    pure ⟨F, _, .captureField F dst op hp (.var src hm) f hf hrecv
      value.code bump.val value.cert bump.property⟩
  | .assign l (.val v) =>
    if hl : locIn F false l = true then do
      let value ← compileVal b F v
      pure ⟨F, _, .storageWrite F l v value.code hl value.cert⟩
    else none
  | .require c => do
    let cond ← compileVal b F c
    pure ⟨F, _, .require F c cond.code cond.cert⟩
  | .revert => some ⟨F, _, .revert F⟩
  | .block body => do
    let result ← compileProg b F body
    pure ⟨result.frag.restrict Γ, result.code, .block body result.code result.cert⟩
  | .ite c thn els => do
    let cond ← compileVal b F c
    let left ← compileProg b F thn
    let right ← compileProg b F els
    pure ⟨(left.frag.restrict Γ).meet (right.frag.restrict Γ), _,
      .ite c thn els cond.code left.code right.code cond.cert left.cert right.cert⟩
  | _ => none

def compileProg (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    (P : Prog C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledProg b F P)
  | .nil => some ⟨F, [], .nil F⟩
  | .cons s P => do
    let head ← compileStmt b F s
    let tail ← compileProg b head.frag P
    pure ⟨tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code, .cons head.cert tail.cert⟩

def compileStmt (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F s)
  | .rebindMem dst (.alias src) => do
    let result ← compileRefPtr b F src
    pure ⟨F, _, .rebind F dst src result.code result.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.index .dyn dst i) (.ref src) => do
    let parent ← compileRefPtr b F dst
    let value ← compileRefPtr b F src
    if hi : valIn F i = true then
      pure ⟨F, _, .reference F dst src parent.code value.code parent.cert value.cert i hi⟩
    else none
  | .assignMem (.index .dyn dst i) (.val v) => do
    let parent ← compileRefPtr b F dst
    if hv : valIn F v = true then
      if hi : valIn F i = true then

def compileStmt (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) :
    Option (CompiledStmt b F s) :=
  match Objects.compileStmt b F s with
  | some r => some ⟨r.frag, r.code, .old r.cert⟩
  | none => if hb : 0 < b then
    match s with
    | .declMem (.array E) x none hd hm => some ⟨_, _, .empty F E x hd hm hb⟩
    | .declMem (.array (.prim p)) x (some (.newArr n _)) _ _ =>
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then some ⟨_, _, .primitive F p x n hb hn⟩ else none
    | .rebindMem (R := .array (.prim p)) dst (.newArr n _) =>
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then some ⟨_, _, .reprimitive F p dst n hb hn⟩ else none
    | .declMem (.array (.ref (.array E))) x (some (.newArr n hn)) _ hm =>
      if hns : simpleIn n = true then
        some ⟨_, _, .nested F E x n hb hns hn (by simpa only [Ty.mapFree] using hm)⟩ else none
    | .rebindMem (R := .array (.ref (.array E))) dst (.newArr n hn) =>
      if hns : simpleIn n = true then
        some ⟨_, _, .renested F E dst n hb hns hn (by
          simpa only [Ty.mapFree] using RefTy.mapFree_of_newArrOk hn)⟩ else none
    | .declMem (.array E) x (some (.newArr (.lit 0 _) hn)) _ hm =>
      some ⟨_, _, .newEmpty F E x hn hm hb⟩
    | .rebindMem (R := .array E) dst (.newArr (.lit 0 _) hn) =>
      some ⟨_, _, .reEmpty F E dst hn hb⟩
    | .declMem R x none hd hm => do
      let builder ← ReferenceDefaults.compileDefault R hm
      pure ⟨_, _, .defaultRef F R x hd hm hb builder⟩
    | .declMem (.array (.ref R)) x (some (.newArr n hn)) _ hm =>
      if hns : simpleIn n = true then do
        let builder ← ReferenceDefaults.compileDefault R (by simpa only [Ty.mapFree] using hm)
        pure ⟨_, _, .reference F R x n hb hns hn _ builder⟩
      else none
    | .rebindMem (R := .array (.ref R)) dst (.newArr n hn) =>
      if hns : simpleIn n = true then do
        let builder ← ReferenceDefaults.compileDefault R (by
          simpa only [Ty.mapFree] using RefTy.mapFree_of_newArrOk hn)
        pure ⟨_, _, .rereference F R dst n hb hns hn _ builder⟩
      else none
    | _ => none
    else none

def compileStmt (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) :
    Option (CompiledStmt b F s) := by
  cases s
  case loop =>
    rename_i a c body
    exact do
      let condition ← Memory.compileVal b F c
      let compiled ← Memory.compileProg b F body
      if stable : compiled.frag.restrict Γ = F then
        pure ⟨F, [.loop condition.code compiled.code],
          .loop a c body condition.code compiled.code compiled.frag condition.cert compiled.cert stable⟩
      else none
  all_goals exact compileFiniteStmt b F _

private def compileStmtM (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) (F : Frag Γ) :
    Option (CompiledStmt b F s) :=
  match s with
  | .block body => do
    let result ← compileProgM b body F
    pure ⟨result.frag.restrict Γ, result.code, .block result.cert⟩
  | .ite c thn els => do
    let condition ← Memory.compileVal b F c
    let left ← compileProgM b thn F
    let right ← compileProgM b els F
    pure ⟨(left.frag.restrict Γ).meet (right.frag.restrict Γ), _,
      .ite condition.cert left.cert right.cert⟩
  | s => compileBase b F s
termination_by structural s

    let tail ← compileProgM b P head.frag
    pure ⟨tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code, .cons head.cert tail.cert⟩

def compileStmt (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) :
    (F : Frag Γ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F s) := by
  induction s using Solidity.Stmt.rec
    (motive_2 := fun Γ Δ P => (F : Frag Γ) → Option (CompiledProg b F P))
  case block body ih =>
    first | intro F | rename_i F
    exact do
      let result ← ih F
      pure ⟨result.frag.restrict _, result.code, .block result.cert⟩
  case ite c thn els iht ihe =>
    first | intro F | rename_i F
    exact do
      let condition ← Memory.compileVal b F c
      let left ← iht F
      let right ← ihe F
      pure ⟨(left.frag.restrict _).meet (right.frag.restrict _), _,
        .ite condition.cert left.cert right.cert⟩
  case nil F =>
    exact some ⟨F, [], .nil F⟩
  case cons s P ihs ihp F =>
    exact do
      let head ← ihs F
      let tail ← ihp head.frag
      pure ⟨tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code, .cons head.cert tail.cert⟩
  all_goals
    first | intro F | rename_i F
    exact compileBase b F _

    (motive_1 := fun Γ Δ P => (F : Frag Γ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F P))
  case block body ih F =>
    exact do
      let result ← ih F
      pure ⟨result.frag.restrict _, result.code, .block result.cert⟩
  case ite c thn els iht ihe F =>
    exact do
      let condition ← Memory.compileVal b F c
      let left ← iht F
      let right ← ihe F
      pure ⟨(left.frag.restrict _).meet (right.frag.restrict _), _,
        .ite condition.cert left.cert right.cert⟩
  case nil =>
    first | intro F | rename_i F
    exact some ⟨F, [], .nil F⟩
  case cons s P ihs ihp =>
    first | intro F | rename_i F
    exact do
      let head ← ihs F
      let tail ← ihp head.frag
      pure ⟨tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code, .cons head.cert tail.cert⟩

    exact compileBase b F _

private def expandCall (b : Nat)
    (previous : {Γ Δ : Ctx} → (F : Frag Γ) → (P : Prog C Γ Δ) → Option (Program b F P))
    {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) : Option (Statement b F s) :=
  match s with
  | @Solidity.Stmt.call _ _ _ ps _ Γf f args ret body =>
    CallRet.casesOn (motive := fun rs _ ret => (body : Prog C (rs ++ ps) Γf) →
      Option (Statement b F (.call f args ret body))) ret
      (fun body => do
        let out ← previous F (expandNone args body)
        pure (equivalent out (expandNone_run f args body)))
      (fun p r res body => do
        let out ← previous F (expandVal args p r res body)
        pure (equivalent out (expandVal_run f args p r res body)))
      (fun _ _ => none)
      (fun R r hd hm body => do
        let out ← previous F (expandMem args R r hd hm body)
        pure (memoryReturn f args R r hd hm body out))
      (fun _ _ _ => none) body
  | _ => none

def compileBump (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) {p : PrimTy}
    (op : IncDec) (hp : p.isNumeric = true) (l : OpLoc C Γ p) :
    Option {code : List Instr // StmtFrag b F F (.incDec op hp l) code} :=
  match l with
  | .mindex .dyn (.var dst hm) i => do
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp
      (.readMem (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) (.simple i))) one
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementMemory F op hp .dyn (.var dst hm) i _
      (.compoundMemory F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp .dyn (.var dst hm) i one _
        (.write F dst hm (.simple i) valueExpr index.code value.code index.cert value.cert))⟩
  | .mfield (.var dst hm) f hf => do
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp
      (.readMem (.field (.var dst hm) f hf)) one
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementField F op hp (.var dst hm) f hf _
      (.compoundField F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp (.var dst hm) f hf one _
        (.writeField F dst hm hf valueExpr value.code value.cert))⟩
  | .mindex .dyn src i => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp
      (.readMem (.index .dyn src (.simple i))) one
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementMemory F op hp .dyn src i _
      (.compoundMemory F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp .dyn src i one _
        (.writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert (.simple i) valueExpr
          index.code value.code index.cert value.cert))⟩
  | .mfield src f hf => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp (.readMem (.field src f hf)) one
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementField F op hp src f hf _
      (.compoundField F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp src f hf one _
        (.writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf valueExpr value.code value.cert))⟩
  | .local dst => do
    let one := incrementOne hp
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp (.simple (.local dst)) one
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨_, .incrementLocal F op hp dst _
      (.compoundLocal F op.binOp (increment_compound op) hp dst one _
        (.assign F dst valueExpr value.code value.cert))⟩
  | _ => none

def compileStmt (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F s)
  | .assignLocal dst e => do
    let value ← compileVal b F e
    pure ⟨F, _, .assign F dst e value.code value.cert⟩
  | .declLocal p x (some e) => do
    let value ← compileVal b F e
    pure ⟨F.push (.val p) .ok, _, .declare F x e value.code value.cert⟩
  | .declLocal p x none => some ⟨F.push (.val p) .ok, _, .declareDefault F p x⟩
  | .rebindMem dst (.alias (.var src hm)) =>
    some ⟨F, _, .rebind F dst src hm⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.rebindMem _ _ (.array (.prim p)) dst (.newArr n _) =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then some ⟨F, _, .reallocate F p dst n hb hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem R x (some (.alias (.var src hm))) _ _ =>
    some ⟨F.push (.mem R) .ok, _, .declareAlias F x src hm⟩
  | .rebindMem dst (.alias src) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨F, _, .rebindPath F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert⟩
  | .declMem R x (some (.alias src)) _ hm => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨F.push (.mem R) .ok, _, .declarePathAlias F x src hm pointer.code pointer.cert⟩
  | .declMem (.struct s) x none hd hm =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then
        some ⟨F.push (.mem (.struct s)) .ok, _, .allocateStruct F s x hd hm hb hp⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem (.struct s) x (some (.copy (.loc (.root root hr)) _)) _ hm =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then do
        let loads ← compileCopyLoads b F root hr (Semantics.structDef s)
        pure ⟨F.push (.mem (.struct s)) .ok, _, .copyStruct F s x root hr hm hb hp loads.code loads.cert⟩
      else none
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.rebindMem _ _ (.struct s) dst (.copy (.loc (.root root hr)) hm) =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then do
        let loads ← compileCopyLoads b F root hr (Semantics.structDef s)
        pure ⟨F, _, .rebindCopyStruct F s dst root hr hm hb hp loads.code loads.cert⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem (.array (.prim p)) x (some (.newArr n _)) _ _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hn : simpleIn n = true then
        some ⟨F.push (.mem (.array (.prim p))) .ok, _, .allocate F p x n hb hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | .declMem (.array (.prim p)) x none _ _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      some ⟨F.push (.mem (.array (.prim p))) .ok, _,
        .defaultArray F p x _ (.allocate F p x (.lit 0 rfl) hb rfl)⟩
    else none
  | .assignMem (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) i) (.val v) => do
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .write F dst hm i v index.code value.code index.cert value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.field (.var dst hm) _ hf) (.val v) => do
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .writeField F dst hm hf v value.code value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.index .dyn src i) (.val v) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert i v index.code value.code index.cert value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.field src _ hf) (.val v) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let value ← compileVal b F v
    pure ⟨F, _, .writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf v value.code value.cert⟩
  | .assignMem (.field dst _ hf) (.ref src) => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b dst
    let value ← compilePtr b src
    pure ⟨F, _, .writeReference F dst src hf pointer.code value.code pointer.cert value.cert⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim _) (.loc (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) i)) _ => do
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    pure ⟨F, _, .deleteElement F dst hm i index.code index.cert⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.array (.prim p))) (.var dst _) _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      some ⟨F, _, .deleteArray F dst _ (.reallocate F p dst (.lit 0 rfl) hb rfl)⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.struct s)) (.var dst hm) hd =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then
        some ⟨F, _, .deleteStruct F dst hd hm hb hp⟩
      else none
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.array (.prim _))) (.loc (.field src _ hf)) _ =>
    if hb : 0 < b then do
      let pointer ← compilePtr b src
      pure ⟨F, _, .deleteArrayField F src hf pointer.code pointer.cert hb⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.ref (.struct t)) (.loc (.field src f hf)) hd =>
    if hb : 0 < b then
      if hp : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef t) = true then do
        let pointer ← compilePtr b src
        pure ⟨F, _, .deleteStructField F src hf hd (MLoc.field src f hf).mapFree
          pointer.code pointer.cert hb hp⟩
      else none
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim p) (.loc (.field (.var dst hm) _ hf)) _ => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (deleteDefaultValue p)
    pure ⟨F, _, .deleteField F (.var dst hm) hf _
      (.writeField F dst hm hf (deleteDefaultValue p) value.code value.cert)⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim p) (.loc (.index .dyn src i)) _ => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let index ← compileVal b F i
    let value ← compileVal b F (deleteDefaultValue p)
    pure ⟨F, _, .deletePathElement F src i _
      (.writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert i (deleteDefaultValue p)
        index.code value.code index.cert value.cert)⟩
  | @Solidity.Stmt.deleteMem _ _ (.prim p) (.loc (.field src _ hf)) _ => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let value ← compileVal b F (deleteDefaultValue p)
    pure ⟨F, _, .deleteField F src hf _
      (.writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf (deleteDefaultValue p) value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mindex .dyn (.var dst hm) i) r => do
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.index .dyn (.var dst hm) (.simple i))) r
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundMemory F op hop hp .dyn (.var dst hm) i r _
      (.write F dst hm (.simple i) valueExpr index.code value.code index.cert value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.local dst) r => do
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.simple (.local dst)) r
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundLocal F op hop hp dst r _ (.assign F dst valueExpr value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mfield (.var dst hm) f hf) r => do
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.field (.var dst hm) f hf)) r
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundField F op hop hp (.var dst hm) f hf r _
      (.writeField F dst hm hf valueExpr value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mindex .dyn src i) r => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.index .dyn src (.simple i))) r
    let index ← compileVal b F (.simple i)
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundMemory F op hop hp .dyn src i r _
      (.writePathArray F src pointer.code pointer.cert (.simple i) valueExpr
        index.code value.code index.cert value.cert)⟩
  | .opAssign op hop hp (.mfield src f hf) r => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    let valueExpr := compoundValue op hop hp (.readMem (.field src f hf)) r
    let value ← compileVal b F valueExpr
    pure ⟨F, _, .compoundField F op hop hp src f hf r _
      (.writePathField F src pointer.code pointer.cert hf valueExpr value.code value.cert)⟩
  | .incDec op hp l => do
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp l
    pure ⟨F, bump.val, bump.property⟩
  | .assignIncDec dst op hp (.mindex .dyn (.var src hm) i) hrecv => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (bumpResultValue op hp
      (.readMem (.index .dyn (.var src hm) (.simple i))))
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp (.mindex .dyn (.var src hm) i)
    pure ⟨F, _, .captureMemory F dst op hp .dyn (.var src hm) i hrecv
      value.code bump.val value.cert bump.property⟩
  | .assignIncDec dst op hp (.local src) hrecv => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (bumpResultValue op hp (.simple (.local src)))
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp (.local src)
    pure ⟨F, _, .captureLocal F dst op hp src hrecv value.code bump.val value.cert bump.property⟩
  | .assignIncDec dst op hp (.mfield (.var src hm) f hf) hrecv => do
    let value ← compileVal b F (bumpResultValue op hp (.readMem (.field (.var src hm) f hf)))
    let bump ← compileBump b F op hp (.mfield (.var src hm) f hf)
    pure ⟨F, _, .captureField F dst op hp (.var src hm) f hf hrecv
      value.code bump.val value.cert bump.property⟩
  | .assign l (.val v) =>
    if hl : locIn F false l = true then do
      let value ← compileVal b F v
      pure ⟨F, _, .storageWrite F l v value.code hl value.cert⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.assignFromMem _ _ (.array (.prim _p)) dst src => do
    if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
      let pointer ← compilePtr b src
      pure ⟨F.dropFragile, _, .copyArrayToStorage F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl⟩
    else none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.assignFromMem _ _ (.struct s) dst src => do
    if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
      if hprim : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then
        if hst : static (.ref (.struct s)) = true then
          if hfit : (Semantics.structDef s).length < W then
            let pointer ← compilePtr b src
            pure ⟨F, _, .copyStructToStorage F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl hprim hst hfit⟩
          else none
        else none
      else none
    else none
  | .require c => do
    let cond ← compileVal b F c
    pure ⟨F, _, .require F c cond.code cond.cert⟩
  | .revert => some ⟨F, _, .revert F⟩
  | .block body => do
    let result ← compileProg b F body
    pure ⟨result.frag.restrict Γ, result.code, .block body result.code result.cert⟩
  | .ite c thn els => do
    let cond ← compileVal b F c
    let left ← compileProg b F thn
    let right ← compileProg b F els
    pure ⟨(left.frag.restrict Γ).meet (right.frag.restrict Γ), _,
      .ite c thn els cond.code left.code right.code cond.cert left.cert right.cert⟩
  | _ => none
acceptors.name: compileStmt

acceptors.definition:
def compileProg (b : Nat) {Γ Δ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    (P : Prog C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledProg b F P)
  | .nil => some ⟨F, [], .nil F⟩
  | .cons s P => do
    let head ← compileStmt b F s
    let tail ← compileProg b head.frag P
    pure ⟨tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code, .cons head.cert tail.cert⟩
acceptors.name: compileProg

intrinsic_memory_branch_features.feature_list: Checked memory-to-storage copying plus restricted scalar operations, blocks/branches and selected memory allocation/path operations; compileCopy/compileStmt retain primitive/array/struct shape and core-location guards.

private def compileCopy (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    {R : RefTy} → (dst : Loc C Γ (.ref R)) → (src : MPath C Γ (.ref R)) →
      Option (CompiledStmt b F (.assignFromMem dst src))
  | .array (.prim _), dst, src => do
    let pointer ← compilePtr b src
    if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
      pure ⟨F.dropFragile, _, .arrayCopy F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl⟩
    else none
  | .struct s, dst, src => do
    if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
      if hprim : primitiveMembers (Semantics.structDef s) = true then
        if hst : static (.ref (.struct s)) = true then
          if hfit : (Semantics.structDef s).length < W then
            let pointer ← compilePtr b src
            pure ⟨F, _, .structCopy F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl hprim hst hfit⟩
          else none
        else none
      else none
    else none
  | .fixed (.prim _) n, dst, src =>
    if hn : n < W then do
      let pointer ← compilePtr b src
      if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
        pure ⟨F, _, .copy F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | _, _, _ => none
acceptors.name: compileCopy

acceptors.definition:
private def compileCopyMem (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    {R : RefTy} → (dst : Loc C Γ (.ref R)) → (src : MPath C Γ (.ref R)) →
      Option (CompiledStmt b F (.assign dst (.copyMem src)))
  | .fixed (.prim _) n, dst, src =>
    if hn : n < W then do
      let pointer ← compilePtr b src
      if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
        pure ⟨F, _, .copyMem F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl hn⟩
      else none
    else none
  | _, _, _ => none
acceptors.name: compileCopyMem

acceptors.definition:
private def compileShape (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) :
    {E : Ty} → {n : Nat} → {R : RefTy} → (dst : Loc C Γ (.ref R)) →
    (src : MPath C Γ (.ref (.fixed E n))) → (shape : FixedCopy E n R) →
    Option (CompiledStmt b F (.assign dst (.fixedCopyMem src shape)))
  | .prim _, _, _, dst, src, shape =>
    FixedCopy.casesOn (motive := fun R shape => (dst : Loc C Γ (.ref R)) →
      Option (CompiledStmt b F (.assign dst (.fixedCopyMem src shape)))) shape
      (dynamic := fun hn dst => do
        let pointer ← compilePtr b src
        if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
          pure ⟨F.dropFragile, _, .dynamic F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl hn⟩
        else none)
      (fixed := fun k hfit dst =>
        if hk : k < W then do
          let pointer ← compilePtr b src
          if hl : locIn F false dst = true then
            pure ⟨F, _, .pad F dst src pointer.code pointer.cert hl hfit hk⟩
          else none
        else none) dst
  | .ref _, _, _, _, _, _ => none
acceptors.name: compileShape

acceptors.definition:
private def compileAssign (b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) {T : Ty}
    (dst : Loc C Γ T) (rhs : Src C Γ T) : Option (CompiledStmt b F (.assign dst rhs)) :=
  Src.casesOn (motive := fun T rhs =>
    (dst : Loc C Γ T) → Option (CompiledStmt b F (.assign dst rhs))) rhs
    (val := fun _ _ => none)
    (copy := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (fixedCopy := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (copyMem := fun src dst => compileCopyMem b F dst src)
    (fixedCopyMem := fun src shape dst => compileShape b F dst src shape) dst

variable (b : Nat)
acceptors.name: compileAssign

acceptors.definition:
def compileStmt : {Γ Δ : Ctx} → (F : Frag Γ) → (s : Stmt C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F s)
  | _, _, F, s => Stmt.casesOn (motive_1 := fun Γ _ s =>
      (F : Frag Γ) → Option (CompiledStmt b F s)) s
    (assign := fun dst rhs F => compileAssign b F dst rhs)
    (rebind := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (assignLocal := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (declLocal := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (declStorage := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (opAssign := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (incDec := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (assignIncDec := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (assignLocalPush := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (pushOpAssign := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (pushIncDec := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (push := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (pop := fun _ _ => none)
    (transfer := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (send := fun _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (declMem := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (rebindMem := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (assignFromMem := fun dst src F => compileCopy b F dst src)
    (assignMem := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (delete := fun _ _ => none)
    (deleteMem := fun _ _ _ => none)
    (assignNew := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (ite := fun c thn els F => do
      let cond ← Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileVal b F c
      let left ← compileProg F thn
      let right ← compileProg F els
      pure ⟨(left.frag.restrict _).meet (right.frag.restrict _), _,
        .ite c thn els cond.code left.code right.code cond.cert left.cert right.cert⟩)
    (require := fun c F => do
      let value ← Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileVal b F c
      pure ⟨F, _, .require F c value.code value.cert⟩)
    (assert := fun _ _ => none)
    (revert := fun F => some ⟨F, _, .revert F⟩)
    (assumeFalse := fun  _ => none)
    (call := fun _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (callReceiver := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (callReceiverPush := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (tryCall := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (loop := fun _ _ _ _ => none)
    (block := fun body F => do
      let result ← compileProg F body
      pure ⟨result.frag.restrict _, result.code, .block body result.code result.cert⟩)
    (callRec := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => none)
    (revertData := fun _ _ => none)
    (catchData := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => none) F

  termination_by structural _ _ _F s => s
acceptors.name: compileStmt

acceptors.definition:
def compileProg : {Γ Δ : Ctx} → (F : Frag Γ) → (P : Prog C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledProg b F P)
  | _, _, F, P => Prog.casesOn (motive_2 := fun Γ _ P =>
      (F : Frag Γ) → Option (CompiledProg b F P)) P
      (fun F => some ⟨F, [], .nil F⟩)
      (fun s tail F => do
        let head ← compileStmt F s
        let rest ← compileProg head.frag tail
        pure ⟨rest.frag, head.code ++ rest.code, .cons head.cert rest.cert⟩) F
  termination_by structural _ _ _F P => P
acceptors.name: compileProg

  match Construction.compileStmt b F s with
  | some r => some ⟨r.frag, r.code, .construction r.cert⟩
  | none => (Fixed.compileStmt b F s).map fun r => ⟨r.frag, r.code, .copying r.cert⟩

def compileProg (b : Nat) : {Γ Δ : Ctx} → (F : Frag Γ) → (P : Prog C Γ Δ) → Option (CompiledProg b F P)

      (fun F => some ⟨F, [], .nil F⟩)
      (fun s P F => do
        let head ← compileStmt b F s
        let tail ← compileProg b head.frag P
        pure ⟨tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code, .cons head.cert tail.cert⟩) F
  termination_by structural _ _ _F P => P
